_contract: PINNED by docs/BUILD_PLAN.md (P4). A disappointing model is a DATA problem - changing these numbers to chase metrics is prohibited; ask first. training/modal_app.py reads every number from this file and never duplicates one in code.

base_model._note: Qwen3 dropped the -Instruct suffix: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B IS the post-trained chat variant (Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-Instruct does not exist on the Hub; Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-Base is the pretrain-only repo). BUILD_PLAN's phrase 'Qwen3-1.7B-Instruct' resolves to this repo. This revision MUST equal the revision in configs/models.json:base - tests/test_training_config.py enforces it.

_smoke_overrides_note: --smoke merges these on top of the resolved config. A key naming a top-level section deep-merges into that section; any other key merges into 'training'. So max_steps lands in training.max_steps, where HF TrainingArguments lets it supersede num_train_epochs.

data._note: P3 schema: {"messages": [system, user, assistant], "meta": {...}}. system must equal eval.SYSTEM_CORE verbatim and enable_thinking must match eval.py's HFGenerator, so the training condition equals the zero_shot eval condition.
